gaps.lead: She speaks French fluently; she also speaks Russian.
gaps.sentence: She speaks French fluently and, ___, Russian.
gaps.explanation: in addition adds a parallel fact: and, in addition, Russian.

gaps.lead: Someone has stolen the mayor's car.
gaps.explanation: Active present perfect (has stolen) becomes passive: has been stolen.

gaps.lead: The lecture was cancelled because nobody came.
gaps.explanation: because so few people came = because hardly anybody came.

gaps.lead: She prefers reading to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.

gaps.answer: got me to promise to do
gaps.lead: The doctor made me promise to do the exercises daily.
gaps.explanation: get somebody TO do something = make/persuade them: got me to promise.

gaps.lead: We took a spare tyre in case the journey went wrong.
gaps.sentence: We took a spare tyre ___ went wrong.
gaps.explanation: in case + clause = as a precaution because something might happen.
